signals.evidence: frontend/packages/shared/src/auth.ts:60-98 — decodeJwt() casts JSON.parse output as JwtPayload without validating exp is numeric; isTokenExpired() then evaluates `undefined <= now+buffer` = false, so exp-less tokens report as never-expiring (client-side expiry BYPASS). Sibling breakage in getTokenExpiration/getTokenRemainingTime. @ppt/shared is imported by ppt-web and mobile.

frontend/packages/shared/src/formatting.ts:93-158 — toDate() is unguarded; every Intl formatter + formatISODate throws RangeError on Invalid Date. Sibling validation.ts already uses Number.isNaN(d.getTime()) guard. @ppt/shared formatters are consumed across ppt-web, reality-web and mobile.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/ai-chat/hooks/useAiChat.ts:30-46 — apiFetch() never attaches `Authorization` header (Bearer scheme); all 6 AI-chat hooks 401. useDeleteSession (:131-142) also raw-fetches without response.ok check, so failed DELETE looks like success. Same defect class as already-fixed code-review-ppt-web-core-raw-fetch-bypasses-jwt-interceptor.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/meters/hooks/useOcrMeterReading.ts:11-99 — ocrFetch() attaches no Authorization header; both authenticated /api/v1/ai/ocr endpoints 401. Same raw-fetch class as ai-chat + person-months. Error is at least surfaced via processing/correctionError, so medium severity.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/contexts/OrganizationProvider.tsx:8-12 — context value is a fresh object literal on every render; every useOrganization() subscriber re-renders on every AuthContext change. Sibling AuthContext + WebSocketContext both useMemo(); OrganizationProvider is the lone hold-out.
